oneLine: Jupiter plans an IPO by mid-2027.

sources.title: Jupiter plans IPO by mid-2027 to fund expansion; targets Rs 6,500 crore revenue in FY28
Jupiter to launch IPO by mid-2027, targets ₹6,500 cr revenue in FY28 | The New Indian Express Chennai - newspaper

synopsis: Solar cell manufacturer Jupiter plans an initial public offering by the middle of next year to fund its expansion plans in fiscal years 2028 and 2029. The company is currently in talks with merchant bankers and expects to finalise its IPO plans in about a month. The IPO proceeds will support the company's scaling of manufacturing capacity, diversification into upstream solar components such as ingots and wafers, and entry into the battery energy storage segment. Jupiter targets revenue of Rs 6,500 crore in FY28, up from a projected Rs 3,000-3,200 crore in the current financial year. Chief executive officer Dhruv Sharma stated that the company currently holds around 5.4 GW of solar cell manufacturing capacity and is commissioning an additional 3 GW facility in Nagpur.
